symptoms: Herpes infections of the lips or mouth in PLHIV

management_steps.details: Children < 15 years of age: 250 mg/m2/dose, 8 hourly for 7 days. Children >= 15 years of age and adults: 400 mg, 8 hourly for 7 days.
Indicated for children with extensive oral herpes provided treatment can be started within 72 hours of onset of symptoms, and PLHIV with herpes infections of the lips or mouth.
